chunks: Surely God is my Lord, and your Lord, so worship Him; and this is the right path.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the straight path and the oneness of God in Surah Aal Imran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to highlight the humanity and prophetic status of Jesus (Isa), affirming his role as a servant of God rather than divine, thereby supporting the concept of *Tawhid* (monotheism). It underscores the continuity of the prophetic message, linking Jesus' call to worship with the broader Islamic tradition of following the straight path (*Sirat al-Mustaqim*) established by previous prophets.
